properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 2 at 11:05PM EDT until September 3 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Detroit/Pontiac MI
properties.description:
At 1105 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Detroit to near Salem to near Fowlerville, moving
southeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect considerable
tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes,
roofs, and outbuildings.

These severe storms will be near...
Livonia, Grosse Pointe, Downtown Detroit, Canton, Detroit,
Dearborn, Salem, Belle Isle, and Whitmore Lake around 1110 PM EDT.
Greenfield Village around 1115 PM EDT.
Taylor and Romulus around 1120 PM EDT.
Wyandotte around 1125 PM EDT.
Trenton around 1140 PM EDT.
Ann Arbor, Grosse Ile, and Dixboro around 1145 PM EDT.
Belleville around 1205 AM EDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include
Whittaker, Melvindale, Gibraltar, Hudson Mills Metropark, New Boston,
Delhi Mills, Pleasant Lake, Rockwood, Harper Woods, and Westland.

People attending Saline Community Fair  should seek safe shelter
immediately!
properties.instruction:
Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

Prepare immediately for large hail and damaging winds. People outside
should move to a shelter, inside a strong building and away from
windows.
